Align a Count Raster onto the Grid of Another Raster

Source: R/align_count_rast.R
align_count_rast.Rd

Resamples a raster of counts (people, livestock heads) onto the grid of template so that it can serve as extraction weights for template, for example with extract_weighted_by_poly().

Usage

align_count_rast(count, template, tolerance = 0.01, iteration = NULL)

Arguments

count

A SpatRaster of counts, in the same CRS as template.

template

A SpatRaster whose grid the counts are put on.

tolerance

Relative margin below which the two resolutions are treated as equal. Default 0.01.

iteration

optional character to be print before computation. Usually, it is the name of the object on which the function is applied. This is useful when the function is used inside an apply family function to keep track of the iterations.

Value

A SpatRaster on the grid of template, with no NA.

Details

A count cannot be interpolated like a continuous value. The method follows the resolutions:

  • template coarser than count: the counts are summed into each template cell, so totals are preserved. When the grids nest (the resolution ratio is a whole number and the cell edges line up, e.g. 30 arc-seconds into 5 arc-minutes) the sum is exact, with terra::aggregate(); otherwise terra::resample() with method = "sum" shares each count by overlap.

  • template as fine as or finer than count: each template cell takes the count of the cell it falls in (method = "near"). Totals are not preserved, but the relative weights between cells are, which is what a weighting needs.

NA counts are set to 0. Weights must have no NA, because exactextractr::exact_extract() returns NaN for a polygon when any of its weight cells is NA.

See also

extract_weighted_by_poly(), terra::resample()

Examples

pop <- terra::rast(xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, res = 0.1,
                   crs = "epsg:4326", vals = 1)
coarse <- terra::rast(xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, res = 0.5,
                      crs = "epsg:4326", vals = 0)
align_count_rast(pop, coarse) # 25 people in each coarse cell
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 2, 2, 1  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 0.5, 0.5  (x, y)
#> extent      : 0, 1, 0, 1  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : lon/lat WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)
#> source(s)   : memory
#> name        : lyr.1
#> min value   :    25
#> max value   :    25
